_note: Rendered to ~/.claude/commands/<name>.md by `install.py --os`. Names that collide with built-in or plugin commands (/plan, /debug, /review, /security-review, /init, /code-review, /docs) are prefixed omnis-. {O} = python ~/.claude/skills/omnis/scripts/omnis.py

analyze.desc: Understand a codebase or an area before changing it (map, entry points, risks).
analyze.body:
Goal: a short, accurate picture of $ARGUMENTS (or the whole repo) without reading everything.
1. `{O} map` once. 2. `{O} find` / `outline` / `deps` for the area. Read only the needed lines.
3. Check `{O} memory search "<topic>"` for recorded decisions.
Report in Turkish, plain language: what it is, how it runs/tests, main modules, where $ARGUMENTS lives, risks/unknowns. No edits.

omnis-plan.desc: Turn a task into a concrete, verifiable plan before coding (OMNIS DEEP mode).
omnis-plan.body:
Task: $ARGUMENTS
Follow ~/.claude/skills/omnis/workflows/deep.md. Output: goal, files to touch (from find/deps), steps (each with how it is verified), risks, rollback, what needs the user's approval. If the task is small (one file), say so and skip the plan.

implement.desc: Implement a change end to end: plan briefly, edit, test, verify, report.
implement.body:
Task: $ARGUMENTS
Route FAST/STANDARD/DEEP as in the omnis skill. Small task → do it directly, no agents.
Large task → plan, then delegate disjoint file sets to at most one editing agent per file set (developer/frontend/backend/database), with code-reviewer and qa afterwards.
`git status` first; save a checkpoint for long work (`{O} checkpoint save`). Finish with `{O} verify --run` and the VERIFIED / NOT VERIFIED / RISKS block.

omnis-debug.desc: Find the root cause of an error or wrong behaviour, then fix it with a regression test.
omnis-debug.body:
Symptom: $ARGUMENTS
Follow ~/.claude/skills/omnis/workflows/debug.md (and the systematic-debugging skill if present).
1. `{O} memory bug match "<error line>"`. 2. Reproduce with `{O} filter "<cmd>"`. 3. Hypothesis → evidence, one at a time. 4. Fix + regression test. 5. `{O} memory bug add ...` for a non-obvious cause.

audit.desc: Broad health audit: security, dependencies, tests, config, dead code. Read-only report.
audit.body:
Area: $ARGUMENTS (default: whole repo). Read-only.
Run: `{O} map`, `{O} security scan .`, dependency audit (npm/pnpm audit, pip-audit if present) through `{O} filter`, test suite through filter, check CI config. Delegate to security-auditor only if the area is large.
Report in Turkish: top 5 issues by impact, each with evidence and fix effort; then quick wins.

omnis-security.desc: Security review of the current diff or an area (complements built-in /security-review).
omnis-security.body:
Target: $ARGUMENTS (default: current diff).
1. `{O} security diff` (secrets). 2. For each changed entry point: trace untrusted input to sinks (SQL, shell, file paths, HTML, URLs fetched server-side, deserialization). 3. AuthZ on every new route. 4. New dependencies: pinned, reputable.
Use the security-audit skill for a full audit request. Findings only with evidence; never print secret values.

omnis-review.desc: OMNIS review of the current diff via the code-reviewer agent (complements built-in /review and /code-review).
omnis-review.body: Diff against $ARGUMENTS (default: HEAD / main). Use the code-reviewer agent on the diff, then the security-auditor only if auth, payments, file or shell handling changed. Merge findings, drop duplicates, order by severity. Do not edit unless the user asks.

test.desc: Run the relevant tests (only what the change touches) and report honestly.
test.body: Scope: $ARGUMENTS (default: current changes). `{O} verify` shows related tests; run them with `{O} filter`. If tests are missing for changed behaviour, propose (or with qa agent write) them. Report exact pass/fail counts and anything not run.

optimize.desc: Measure, find the top cost, fix it, re-measure.
optimize.body: Target: $ARGUMENTS. No change without a baseline number. Use the performance agent for analysis if the area is large. Apply the smallest change with the largest measured gain, re-measure, report before/after.

refactor.desc: Behaviour-preserving restructuring with tests as the safety net.
refactor.body: Target: $ARGUMENTS. 1. `{O} deps` for blast radius. 2. Make sure tests cover current behaviour (add characterization tests if not). 3. Small steps, tests green after each. 4. No behaviour change, no API change unless asked. Report what moved and proof that behaviour is unchanged.

omnis-docs.desc: Write or update docs from the actual code (README, guides, changelog).
omnis-docs.body: Document $ARGUMENTS. Use the docs agent for large docs. Verify every command you document by running it or mark it unverified. Update existing files first.

release.desc: Prepare a release: version bump, changelog, tag plan. Does not publish without approval.
release.body: Version: $ARGUMENTS. 1. Tests + build green (filter). 2. `{O} security diff`. 3. Changelog entry from commits since the last tag (changelog-automation skill if useful). 4. Bump version where the project keeps it. 5. Show the user the exact tag/publish commands and ask once before running them.

deploy.desc: Prepare and run a deploy only after explicit approval; always with a rollback step.
deploy.body: Target: $ARGUMENTS. Production change → ask the user first (one clear Turkish sentence). Before: build/tests green, backup or rollback plan written down, secrets via env only. After: health check, smoke test, report. Never rm storage directories; never change host firewalls without a timed rollback.

cleanup.desc: Find dead code, stale files, unused deps and caches; remove only after approval.
cleanup.body: Area: $ARGUMENTS. Read-only first: unused exports (find with zero references), unused dependencies, stale build artifacts, `.omnis` caches (`{O} clean`). Present a list with evidence; delete only what the user approves, via git so it is reversible.

research.desc: Answer a technical question from current official sources, with citations.
research.body: Question: $ARGUMENTS. Use the research agent (or deep-research skill for a big topic). Official docs first, note versions/dates, cite sources, separate facts from inference.

project-onboard.desc: Adapt OMNIS to this project: detect stack, recommend relevant skills/agents, save the project map.
project-onboard.body: Run `python ~/.claude/skills/omnis/scripts/project_adapt.py $ARGUMENTS` and `{O} map`. Explain in Turkish which skills/agents fit and why; offer to install missing recommended skills via /skills-install (plan first). Record durable facts with `{O} memory add architecture "..."`.

task-report.desc: Report the current task's state: done, next, changed files, verification. Saves a checkpoint.
task-report.body: Summarise this session's task in Turkish: done, remaining, changed files (git status), verification state. Then `{O} checkpoint save --task "..." --done "a;b" --next "c;d"` so it survives compaction or a new session.

skills-discover.desc: Search the curated OMNIS skill catalog (and GitHub with --github).
skills-discover.body: Run `{O} skills search $ARGUMENTS` and present results in Turkish with one line each on when it helps.

skills-install.desc: Install a skill safely: plan + audit first, install after approval.
skills-install.body: Run `{O} skills plan $ARGUMENTS`, show the plan and any warnings in Turkish, ask once. After approval: `{O} skills install $ARGUMENTS --yes` (add --allow-warn only if the user accepted the shown warnings). Check for name collisions with plugin skills first (`python ~/.claude/skills/omnis/scripts/skill_registry.py --dupes`).

skills-update.desc: Re-audit OMNIS-managed skills and show available updates.
skills-update.body: Run `{O} skills update $ARGUMENTS` (report only). Show changes; apply with --yes after approval.

skills-audit.desc: Static security audit of a skill directory.
skills-audit.body: Run `{O} audit $ARGUMENTS` and explain the findings in plain Turkish.

skills-remove.body: Show what will be removed, ask once, then `{O} skills remove $ARGUMENTS --yes`.

skills-list.desc: Skill registry: every skill with source, commit, date, audit, category, enabled; duplicates.
skills-list.body: Run `python ~/.claude/skills/omnis/scripts/skill_registry.py` and summarise in Turkish (counts per source, duplicates, unaudited ones).

automation-status.desc: List OMNIS automations (interval, state, last result).
automation-status.body: Run `python ~/.claude/skills/omnis/scripts/automation.py status` and explain in Turkish.

automation-add.desc: Add a read-only recurring job (Windows Task Scheduler + toast).
automation-add.body: Run `python ~/.claude/skills/omnis/scripts/automation.py add $ARGUMENTS`. Default interval 5h; offer 1/2/3/8/12/24h or custom. These jobs only read/report/notify. Do not duplicate the in-session 5-hour limit-resume rule.

automation-remove.desc: Remove an automation and its scheduled task.

automation-config.desc: Change an automation's interval or repos.

automation-run.desc: Run an automation now and show its report.
automation-run.body: Run `python ~/.claude/skills/omnis/scripts/automation.py run $ARGUMENTS` and summarise the report in Turkish.
